content: VLAN specific sending behavior The VlanMembership . sendActivity defines for a CouplingPort and VLAN the sending behavior: • sentTagged : packet is sent at this CouplingPort with the defined VLAN-ID • sentUntagged : packet is sent at this CouplingPort but the VLAN-ID is re- moved before sending • notSent : packet is not sent at this CouplingPort
